# Olivabot

> Olivabot B.V. (Amsterdam, Netherlands) builds arboreal robots for agriculture and helps growers choose the right farm robot.

Olivabot is a European Dutch company. We build robots that work in tree canopies (Gibbon Bot, field-tested in olive groves) and we advise farms and agritech teams on which agricultural robots can actually help now.

## Services

- [Agricultural consulting](https://olivabot.com/en/services/agriculture-robotics.html): which farm robot can help now. 45-minute call + written report.
- [GDPR consulting](https://olivabot.com/en/services/gdpr-consulting.html): cameras, sensors, databases, leak risks. 45-minute call + report. Not legal advice.
- [Efficient firmware](https://olivabot.com/en/services/firmware.html): energy and compute on the device. Remote consulting or a firmware upgrade.
- [Efficient software](https://olivabot.com/en/services/efficient-software.html): C++, Rust, local LLM agents on EU servers. Fintech and robotics, Amsterdam.
- [Computer vision](https://olivabot.com/en/services/computer-vision.html): photos/cameras in, labels out, EU server.
- [CAD](https://olivabot.com/en/services/cad.html): files for 3D print or a supplier. We do not print.
- [EU web app](https://olivabot.com/en/services/web-app-mvp.html): 1–2 weeks, data in Europe. Optional sensor dashboard.
